|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[A Cunning Warrior]] (version 3 of 3). It is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[A Cunning Warrior]]): the card image at official release (29 December 2024, for the Virtual Set 24 release (“Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”))<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the Virtual Set 24 release (“Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”).</ref> prints: “If your [Skywalker] Epic Event on table, deploy on table. Where you have a Skywalker, you initiate battles for free. Once per turn, may deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber or a [Cloud City] corridor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle involving a Jedi Skywalker, may activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The border strip beside the copyright line (right edge of the picture) was redrawn: silver weathering now shows over the red. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible image change is a version, however slight). The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Cunning Warrior (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 February 2025: “If your [Skywalker] Epic Event on table, deploy on table. Where you have a Skywalker, you initiate battles for free. Once per turn, may deploy Anakin's Lightsaber or a [Cloud City] corridor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle involving a Jedi Skywalker, may activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[A Cunning Warrior]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[A Cunning Warrior]] (published 30 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•A Cunning Warrior”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[A Jedi's Concentration]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (2 February 2025, on 2 February 2025)<ref name="ht-f004c6a">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/f004c6a7a6acb216e5ea1ff795bb023c921c0a84/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/acunningwarrior.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/f004c6a7a6acb216e5ea1ff795bb023c921c0a84 f004c6a] “Cunning Warrior fix”, 2 February 2025, on 2 February 2025.</ref> prints: “If your [Skywalker] Epic Event on table, deploy on table. Where you have a Skywalker, you initiate battles for free. Once per turn, may deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber or a [Cloud City] corridor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle involving a Jedi Skywalker, may activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The set icon “24” at bottom right was redrawn. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible image change is a version, however slight). The card image prints no errata mark.
